verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ וְזִקְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־ וַיְצַ֤ו הָעָ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר שָׁמֹר֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הַמִּצְוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֧ר אָנֹכִ֛י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֖ם הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh wə·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- way·ṣaw hā·‘ām lê·mōr šā·mōr ’eṯ- kāl- ham·miṣ·wāh ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Then Moses and the elders of Israel - commanded the people . . . Keep - all the commandments - I am giving you today

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בַּיּוֹם֮ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ אֶל־ הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ נֹתֵ֣ן לָ֑ךְ וַהֲקֵמֹתָ֤ לְךָ֙ גְּדֹל֔וֹת אֲבָנִ֣ים וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bay·yō·wm ’ă·šer ta·‘aḇ·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lāḵ wa·hă·qê·mō·ṯā lə·ḵā gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·śaḏ·tā ’ō·ṯām baś·śîḏ
verses.literal: And on the day - you cross - the Jordan into the land that the LORD your God is giving you set up large stones and coat them with plaster

verses.original: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ עֲלֵיהֶ֗ן כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַזֹּ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֥ה אֶֽת־ בְּעָבְרֶ֑ךָ לְמַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁר֩ תָּבֹ֨א אֶל־ הָאָ֜רֶץ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֣יךָ׀ נֹתֵ֣ן לְךָ֗ אֶ֣רֶץ זָבַ֤ת חָלָב֙ וּדְבַ֔שׁ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ אֲבֹתֶ֖יךָ לָֽךְ׃ דִּבֶּ֛ר
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tā ‘ă·lê·hen kāl- diḇ·rê haz·zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh ’eṯ- bə·‘ā·ḇə·re·ḵā lə·ma·‘an ’ă·šer tā·ḇō ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ăšer- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇaš ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- ’ă·ḇō·ṯe·ḵā lāḵ dib·ber
verses.literal: Write on them all the words of this law - when you have crossed over to - enter . . . the land that the LORD your God is giving you a land flowing with milk and honey just as the LORD the God of your fathers has promised you

verses.original: וְהָיָה֮ בְּעָבְרְכֶ֣ם אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֒ תָּקִ֜ימוּ אֶת־ הָאֵ֗לֶּה הָאֲבָנִ֣ים בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר אָנֹכִ֜י מְצַוֶּ֥ה אֶתְכֶ֛ם הַיּ֖וֹם וְשַׂדְתָּ֥ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּשִּֽׂיד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·‘ā·ḇə·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên tā·qî·mū ’eṯ- hā·’êl·leh hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm bə·har ‘ê·ḇāl ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·weh ’eṯ·ḵem hay·yō·wm wə·śaḏ·tā ’ō·w·ṯām baś·śîḏ
verses.literal: And when you have crossed - the Jordan you are to set up - these stones on Mount Ebal as I am commanding you today - - and you are to coat them with plaster

verses.original: וּבָנִ֤יתָ שָּׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ מִזְבַּ֣ח אֲבָנִ֔ים לֹא־ תָנִ֥יף בַּרְזֶֽל׃ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·nî·ṯā šām miz·bê·aḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā miz·baḥ ’ă·ḇā·nîm lō- ṯā·nîp̄ bar·zel ‘ă·lê·hem
verses.literal: Moreover, you are to build there an altar to the LORD your God an altar of stones You must not use any iron tool on them

verses.original: תִּבְנֶ֔ה אֶת־ מִזְבַּ֖ח יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ שְׁלֵמוֹת֙ אֲבָנִ֤ים וְהַעֲלִ֤יתָ עָלָיו֙ עוֹלֹ֔ת לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: tiḇ·neh ’eṯ- miz·baḥ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā šə·lê·mō·wṯ ’ă·ḇā·nîm wə·ha·‘ă·lî·ṯā ‘ā·lāw ‘ō·w·lōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: You shall build - the altar of the LORD your God with uncut stones and offer upon it burnt offerings to the LORD your God

verses.original: שָּׁ֑ם וְזָבַחְתָּ֥ שְׁלָמִ֖ים וְאָכַ֣לְתָּ וְשָׂ֣מַחְתָּ֔ לִפְנֵ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: šām wə·zā·ḇaḥ·tā šə·lā·mîm wə·’ā·ḵal·tā wə·śā·maḥ·tā lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: There you are to sacrifice [your] peace offerings eating them and rejoicing in the presence of the LORD your God

verses.original: וְכָתַבְתָּ֣ בַּאֵ֥ר הֵיטֵֽב׃ס עַל־ הָאֲבָנִ֗ים אֶֽת־ כָּל־ דִּבְרֵ֛י הַזֹּ֖את הַתּוֹרָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵā·ṯaḇ·tā ba·’êr hê·ṭêḇ ‘al- hā·’ă·ḇā·nîm ’eṯ- kāl- diḇ·rê haz·zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh
verses.literal: And you shall write distinctly . . . upon these stones - all the words of this law

verses.original: מֹשֶׁה֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר אֶ֥ל כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לֵאמֹ֑ר הַסְכֵּ֤ת׀ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּשְׁמַע֙ הַזֶּה֙ הַיּ֤וֹם נִהְיֵ֣יתָֽ לְעָ֔ם לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·šeh hal·wî·yim wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm way·ḏab·bêr ’el kāl- yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr has·kêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·šə·ma‘ haz·zeh hay·yō·wm nih·yê·ṯā lə·‘ām Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā
verses.literal: Then Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel . . . Be silent O Israel and listen This day you have become the people of the LORD your God

verses.original: וְשָׁ֣מַעְתָּ֔ בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֑יךָ וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֶת־ מִצְוֺתָו֙ וְאֶת־ חֻקָּ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֛ר אָנֹכִ֥י מְצַוְּךָ֖ הַיּֽוֹם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ma‘·tā bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ’eṯ- miṣ·w·ṯå̄w wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qāw ’ă·šer ’ā·nō·ḵî mə·ṣaw·wə·ḵā hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: You shall therefore obey the voice of the LORD your God and follow - His commandments - and statutes - I am giving you today . . .

verses.original: הַה֖וּא לֵאמֹֽר׃ בַּיּ֥וֹם מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶת־ וַיְצַ֤ו הָעָ֔ם
verses.transliteration: ha·hū lê·mōr bay·yō·wm mō·šeh ’eṯ- way·ṣaw hā·‘ām
verses.literal: On that . . . day Moses - commanded the people

verses.original: בְּעָבְרְכֶ֖ם אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּ֑ן אֵ֠לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֞וּ עַל־ הַ֣ר גְּרִזִ֔ים לְבָרֵ֤ךְ אֶת־ הָעָם֙ שִׁמְעוֹן֙ וְלֵוִ֣י וִֽיהוּדָ֔ה וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר וְיוֹסֵ֥ף וּבִנְיָמִֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·‘ā·ḇə·rə·ḵem ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên ’êl·leh ya·‘am·ḏū ‘al- har gə·ri·zîm lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām šim·‘ō·wn wə·lê·wî wî·hū·ḏāh wə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār wə·yō·w·sêp̄ ū·ḇin·yā·min
verses.literal: When you have crossed - the Jordan these [tribes] shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless - the people Simeon Levi Judah Issachar Joseph and Benjamin

verses.original: וְאֵ֛לֶּה יַֽעַמְד֥וּ בְּהַ֣ר עֵיבָ֑ל עַל־ הַקְּלָלָ֖ה רְאוּבֵן֙ גָּ֣ד וְאָשֵׁ֔ר וּזְבוּלֻ֖ן דָּ֥ן וְנַפְתָּלִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh ya·‘am·ḏū bə·har ‘ê·ḇāl ‘al- haq·qə·lā·lāh rə·’ū·ḇên gāḏ wə·’ā·šêr ū·zə·ḇū·lun dān wə·nap̄·tā·lî
verses.literal: And these [tribes] shall stand on Mount Ebal to deliver the curse Reuben Gad Asher Zebulun Dan and Naphtali

verses.original: וְעָנ֣וּ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם וְאָֽמְר֛וּ רָֽם׃ס ק֥וֹל אֶל־ כָּל־ אִ֥ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nū hal·wî·yim wə·’ā·mə·rū rām qō·wl ’el- kāl- ’îš yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Then the Levites shall proclaim in a loud voice to every Israelite . . .

verses.original: אָר֣וּר הָאִ֡ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂה֩ פֶ֨סֶל וּמַסֵּכָ֜ה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֗ה מַעֲשֵׂ֛ה יְדֵ֥י חָרָ֖שׁ וְשָׂ֣ם בַּסָּ֑תֶר כָל־ הָעָ֛ם וְאָמְר֖וּ וְעָנ֧וּ אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr hā·’îš ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh p̄e·sel ū·mas·sê·ḵāh tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ma·‘ă·śêh yə·ḏê ḥā·rāš wə·śām bas·sā·ṯer ḵāl hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mə·rū wə·‘ā·nū ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is the man who makes a carved idol or molten image an abomination to the LORD the work of the hands of a craftsman and sets it up in secret And {let} all the people . . . say Amen

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַקְלֶ֥ה אָבִ֖יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr maq·leh ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who dishonors his father or mother And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַסִּ֖יג רֵעֵ֑הוּ גְּב֣וּל כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr mas·sîḡ rê·‘ê·hū gə·ḇūl kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who moves his neighbor’s boundary stone And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֕וּר עִוֵּ֖ר מַשְׁגֶּ֥ה בַּדָּ֑רֶךְ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ‘iw·wêr maš·geh bad·dā·reḵ kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who lets a blind man wander in the road And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֗וּר מַטֶּ֛ה מִשְׁפַּ֥ט גֵּר־ יָת֖וֹם וְאַלְמָנָ֑ה כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr maṭ·ṭeh miš·paṭ gêr- yā·ṯō·wm wə·’al·mā·nāh kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner the fatherless or the widow And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־ אָבִ֔יו אֵ֣שֶׁת כִּ֥י גִלָּ֖ה אָבִ֑יו כְּנַ֣ף כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ’ā·ḇîw ’ê·šeṯ kî ḡil·lāh ’ā·ḇîw kə·nap̄ kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who sleeps with his father’s wife for he has violated his father’s marriage bed And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ כָּל־ בְּהֵמָ֑ה כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- kāl- bə·hê·māh kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who lies with any animal And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֗וּר שֹׁכֵב֙ עִם־ אֲחֹת֔וֹ בַּת־ אָבִ֖יו א֣וֹ בַת־ אִמּ֑וֹ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ’ă·ḥō·ṯōw baṯ- ’ā·ḇîw ’ōw ḇaṯ- ’im·mōw kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who sleeps with his sister the daughter of his father or the daughter of his mother And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֕וּר שֹׁכֵ֖ב עִם־ חֹֽתַנְתּ֑וֹ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ḥō·ṯan·tōw kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who sleeps with his mother-in-law And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֕וּר מַכֵּ֥ה רֵעֵ֖הוּ בַּסָּ֑תֶר כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr mak·kêh rê·‘ê·hū bas·sā·ṯer kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who strikes down his neighbor in secret And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָרוּר֙ לֹקֵ֣חַ שֹׁ֔חַד לְהַכּ֥וֹת נָקִ֑י נֶ֖פֶשׁ דָּ֣ם כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr lō·qê·aḥ šō·ḥaḏ lə·hak·kō·wṯ nā·qî ne·p̄eš dām kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who accepts a bribe to kill an innocent person . . . And {let} all the people say Amen

verses.original: אָר֗וּר אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ יָקִ֛ים אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י הַזֹּ֖את הַתּוֹרָֽה־ לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑ם כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם וְאָמַ֥ר אָמֵֽן׃פ
verses.transliteration: ’ā·rūr ’ă·šer lō- yā·qîm ’eṯ- diḇ·rê haz·zōṯ hat·tō·w·rāh- la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯām kāl- hā·‘ām wə·’ā·mar ’ā·mên
verses.literal: Cursed is he who does not put - the words of this law into practice - And {let} all the people say Amen
